label: Project ID
description: Unique project ID with first 4 letters of ranch name, year (YY) of practice implementation, and conservation practice abbreviation (see practice_abbreviations.csv)

label: Sample ID
description: Unique sample ID for each sampling location with project_id, treatment (T) or control (C), and sample number

label: Timepoint
description: Timepoint of sampling event, indicating baseline (T0), first sampling after practice implementation (T1), and following events (T2, T3, etc)

label: ABH Sampling Date
description: Date of aboveground herbaceous biomass sampling event

label: Plot Area for ABH sampling
description: Plot area for aboveground herbaceous biomass

label: End Depth for Root Biomass Sampling
description: End sampling depth for herbaceous root biomass

label: Woody Biomass Method
description: Method used for estimating woody biomass

label: AWB Sampling Date
description: Date of woody biomass sampling event

label: Tree species identified
description: Genus and species of all identified trees surrounding point if using LCH or PCQ abw method

label: Average tree distance from sampling point
description: Average tree distance from sampling point if using LCH or PCQ abw method

label: Percent of sample units with tree presence
description: Percent of sample units (4 for PCQ or 2 for LCH) with measurable trees

label: Aboveground Woody Biomass (mean per tree)
description: Average aboveground woody biomass for trees surrounding sampling point

label: Belowground Woody Biomass (mean per tree)
description: Average belowground woody biomass for trees surrounding sampling point
